situation (example wording): "Aggravated assault victims in Nashville by sex and month in 2023" (a breakdown by month or by quarter)
what the app does today: Declined: "Breakdowns are available by year, not by month or as rolling totals." (the live tab's yearly summary tables).
proposed behavior: The new engine answers it from the monthly build: each month's (or quarter's) categories with each category's share of that period, the months in order, Unknown last. A quarter is the sum of its three months, known only when all three are. An agency's breakdown first; a state's or the nation's next. Rolling breakdowns, and by year and by month at once, stay declined.
exact default or choices offered: Breakdowns by month and by quarter for one agency.
why: Jeff asked for it directly; the limit was the old yearly tables, not the data.
